verdict.rationale: Datalab documents an official CLI, the `datalab` command, under its SDK docs, with concrete conversion commands that set the output format and processing mode, and a probe confirms the CLI documentation page exists. The documented scope covers document conversion only, and only first-party sources support it. Missing for 10: evidence that the CLI covers extraction, segmentation, pipelines and form filling; agent-oriented features such as machine-readable output or non-interactive auth; independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Use the Datalab CLI to convert documents from the command line.
